name: security-advisory-release
description: Critical security advisory in a small repository, fixed in a published release.

story.title: Signature check bypass in invoice decoder

events.body: The invoice decoder in versions before 2.8.3 read payment details before checking the invoice signature. A crafted invoice could make the wallet display a different payee than the one that would be paid. Patched in v2.8.3. Users should upgrade.
events.title: Signature check bypass in invoice decoder

events.body: Security release. Fixes a signature verification bypass in the invoice decoder (CVE-2026-48211). All users should upgrade.
events.title: v2.8.3

events.body: Moves signature verification ahead of payee parsing so unsigned fields are never shown to the user.
events.title: Verify invoice signature before decoding payment details

cannedOutput.headline: bolt-wallet-kit releases v2.8.3 to fix a critical invoice signature flaw
cannedOutput.whatHappened: The maintainers of bolt-wallet-kit published version 2.8.3. It fixes a critical security flaw in the part of the library that reads payment invoices.
cannedOutput.previously: Older versions read the payment details in an invoice before checking its signature. A fake invoice could make the wallet show the wrong person to pay.
cannedOutput.whatChanged: Version 2.8.3 checks the invoice signature first. Details that are not signed are never shown to the user.
cannedOutput.whyItMatters: Wallet apps built on this library could show users the wrong payee, and people could send money to the wrong place. The maintainers ask all users to upgrade.
cannedOutput.nextConfirmed: The advisory tells all users to upgrade to version 2.8.3.
cannedOutput.nextSpeculative: Wallet apps that use this library might publish their own updates soon.

glossary.definition: A payment request that says who should be paid and how much.
A digital seal that proves who created a message and that nobody changed it.
A public notice that describes a security flaw and how to fix it.
A public ID number for a known security flaw, here CVE-2026-48211.

cannedOutput.analogy: It is like a cashier who read the name on a check before confirming the signature. Now the signature is checked first.
cannedOutput.intermediate: The decoder parsed payee fields before verifying the invoice signature. Pull request #431 moves verification first, and release v2.8.3 ships the fix.
cannedOutput.technical: Signature verification now precedes payee parsing in the invoice decoder (CVE-2026-48211, GHSA-7x2q-9fvm-r4wp). Unsigned fields are no longer surfaced to callers.
